title: Attach recent HABIT events to the ranker request

chapters.title: Why this change
chapters.lead:
The ranker scores candidates with four base features from Tardis and nothing about what the user did this week. This PR reads the last 7 days of HABIT events through TFS v2 and sends them along as a new proto field.

FeedRequestBuilder.BuildTardis.Fetchhabit.RecentEventsRankerRequest

steps.text: Before this PR, Builder.Build fetches four base keys from Tardis and wraps them. No per-user event history reaches the ranker.
The new habit.Fetcher reads HABIT events from TFS v2: one key per hourly bucket in the window, decoded newest first.
Decoding stops at 50 rows, so a heavy user cannot blow up the request size.
That is the whole path. Green is new, blue is changed; the rest of the walkthrough follows the call from left to right.

chapters.title: Request path & failure mode
chapters.lead:
The habit call runs after Tardis, not alongside it, so its latency adds straight onto every feed request. On error the feed still serves, without the signal.

Tardis.Fetch · 18 mshabit.RecentEvents · 12 msp99 30 ms of 40

steps.text: The new call starts only after Tardis.Fetch returns. Both need only the user id, so they could share an errgroup.
The fetcher caps itself with a 30 ms deadline, which bounds the worst case at roughly 48 ms p99.

A TFS error comes back from the fetcher wrapped (top); the builder logs it at warn and sends an empty list (below). habit_events is repeated, so the ranker reads nil as "no signal".

Nothing counts degraded requests.
Yet b.metrics is already injected: a habit_degraded_total counter is one line.

chapters.title: Proto, storage & tests
chapters.lead: Field 12 is appended, never reused, so older ranker builds ignore it. The table is additive and its index matches the window read.

steps.text: A new HabitEvent message and field 12 on RankerRequest. Wire compatible in both directions.
The offline sink. (user_id, ts DESC) serves "last N for a user" without a sort.
Two tests: the deadline fires, and decoding caps at 50. Nothing exercises the degrade branch in Build.
